cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: bioAffinity announced a ~$4.0m registered direct offering plus concurrent private-placement warrants at $6.122 at 12:07 ET on 2026-10-08. The deal closed and the shares were delivered on 2026-10-09 (closing PR 11:37 ET, WallachBeth PR 12:30 ET, 424B5 filed 12:00 ET). The new holders could sell from the open, and the stock fell from the $5.64 prior close to $4.805, well below the deal price.

evidence.claim: 116,545 shares at $6.122 plus 536,836 pre-funded warrants at $6.115, and 980,072 unregistered warrants at $6.122 exercisable only after stockholder approval. Gross $3,996,241, net about $3.7m. Shares outstanding go from 1,166,625 to 1,283,170 before the pre-funded warrants. Delivery on or about 2026-10-09.
Supplement No. 1 cuts the WallachBeth ATM to zero. Last reported sale $5.64 on 2026-10-08.
News timeline: definitive agreement announced 2026-10-08 12:07 PM, WallachBeth pricing PR 1:30 PM, closing announced 2026-10-09 11:37 AM, WallachBeth closing PR 12:30 PM.
EDGAR feed shows no filing after the 12:00 ET 424B5. The Item 1.01/3.02 8-K for the purchase agreement is not yet filed.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The Item 1.01/3.02 8-K for the 2026-10-08 securities purchase agreement, due by 2026-10-14 (four business days), so it may land inside the window. Its content is already public in the 424B5 and the PRs.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A tape showing the 653k delivered shares already sold (close-day volume well above about 700k on a weak close) would move this toward a flat-to-up Monday. A DEF 14A or a new financing 8-K inside the window would move it further down.

positioning_check: Short interest was 71,167 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, days to cover 1.0, up 61.9% from 43,959 on 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/BIAF/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). The lag is about 8 business days, so the 09-30 settlement and the position carried into this fall cannot be seen yet. Float is about 1.16m shares held by non-affiliates (ATM supplement), or 1.28m outstanding after the deal plus 0.54m pre-funded. No insider trades in 12 months (Nasdaq insider API). No option chain, so no skew. Warrant overhang: 980,072 new warrants at $6.122, 19,602 placement-agent warrants, and the August 2026 warrants (1,128,272 shares in the PRE 14A) awaiting stockholder approval. A warrant-arbitrage holder has a reason to keep selling common.

findings.finding: The company cannot add supply in the window. The WallachBeth ATM was reduced to zero on 2026-10-09, and the 2026-10-08 purchase agreement bars new issuance for 30 days and ATM, equity-line and variable-rate deals for 6 months. The commonest second leg for this stage (an ATM draw into a bounce) is closed.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Both restrictions are in force from 2026-10-09 and cover the whole window. A reader who sees the 424B5 tonight learns that no company paper can meet a Monday bounce.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has raised repeatedly through WallachBeth (Oct 2025 RD, Jun 2026 S-1 offering, Aug 2026 PIPE, now Oct 2026 RD). After the Aug 13 2026 PIPE pricing day (-19.03%) the next close was +4.96%. After the Jun 16 2026 offering day (-31.02%) it was -11.96%.
findings.why_not_priced: The intraday tape priced the new paper being sold. It has not priced the absence of further company paper, which is the usual reason microcap fallers keep falling. If it had, the stock would hold near the pro forma net tangible book value per share of $4.80 instead of trading like an open-ended issuer.
findings.independence: The 30-day standstill and 6-month ATM/variable-rate ban are written in the RD prospectus supplement: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1712762/000149315226046454/form424b5.htm

findings.finding: Investor supply from the deal may not be spent. 653,381 freely tradeable shares (116,545 common plus 536,836 pre-funded warrants at $0.007) were delivered on 2026-10-09 to an investor whose economics sit in 980k warrants that need stockholder approval. Today's volume to 15:05 was about $2.7m, roughly 530k shares at about $5.1, so the holder may still be selling Monday.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares and pre-funded warrants were delivered on 2026-10-09 with no lock-up on the investor. Any unsold residue is sold in the next session, inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jun 2026 offering: -31.02% on the day, then -11.96% the next session as new paper kept coming. Aug 2026 PIPE: -19.03% on pricing day, then +4.96%. Mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: The close holds whatever share of the 653k was sold today. The countable supply is about as large as the whole day's volume, so it cannot be shown spent. If it were, the close-day volume would clearly exceed the delivered block on a stabilising tape.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline volume: dollar_volume_d $2.71m against a 20-day median of $1.67m (2.13x). The share conversion is my own approximation, so this is an inference, not a second source.

outside_window.finding: Special meeting to approve the August 2026 warrants (1,128,272 shares) and up to [10m] shares in non-public offerings. PRE 14A filed 2026-09-29, meeting date blank. It will probably need amending to cover the new 980,072 warrants, and approval unlocks a large exercisable overhang.
Q3 2026 10-Q / results. The date is only a Zacks estimate (2026-11-13), not company-announced. The company has already pre-released 100%+ Q3 unit growth (8-K 2026-10-06).

The 30-day issuance standstill ends around 2026-11-08 and the 6-month ATM ban around 2027-04-09. Cash was $2.43m at 2026-06-30 and $9.48m pro forma as adjusted, so the next raise is likely within quarters.
